note: Set B is better because it captures the drawing scales (3/8" = 1'-0") for both sections, which are present in the text layer and image, whereas Set A omits this information entirely. Both sets accurately extract the elevation data (Grade Level and Finished Floor) for the East and West modules. Set B is more redundant (multiple claims for the same elevation data with slightly different entity labels), but these are not incorrect, just repetitive. Set A is cleaner but less complete.
